desc: Vertical closing edge of a clear framed shower door nearly closed against a white tiled jamb, with a continuous transparent vinyl side seal, narrow even gap, and clean metal frame in close view.
reuse_notes: Use for shower-door side seals, glass-door alignment, jamb gaps, water-containment checks, and related bathroom maintenance articles. It depicts a generic shower-door closing detail, never a JK Prestige project or a guarantee that a side seal alone resolves all water escape.
